blocks.text: Upper Deer Lake Burnaby Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Upper Deer Lake is the Burnaby South neighbourhood on the higher ground above Deer Lake Park, on streets including Sperling Avenue, Deer Lake Drive, Walker Avenue and Stanley Street.

blocks.text: Upper Deer Lake Burnaby Houses: the housing stock

items.t: The oldest stock is the park-side heritage houses: the Moore House at 5145 Sperling Avenue, built 1941, sits in the Deer Lake Park Heritage Precinct.
Deer Lake Park was established in 1949 on the lake's eastern shore; the area retained much of its rural character as Burnaby urbanised.
The 1965 Baldwin House at 6543 and 6545 Deer Lake Drive, designed by Arthur Erickson, is the newest protected building in Burnaby's heritage inventory.

blocks.text: Upper Deer Lake Burnaby Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Heritage compliance is monitored: Burnaby checks heritage sites against its bylaws, Heritage Revitalization Agreements and conservation standards.
Lots near the lake or its creeks can fall in the Streamside Protection Development Permit system, needing a Qualified Environmental Professional's report on the setback area.

blocks.text: Upper Deer Lake Burnaby Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Burnaby Village Museum is spread across 4 hectares (10 acres) in Deer Lake Park and represents Burnaby with emphasis on the 1920s.
The Burnaby Art Gallery in the park is the only public art museum in Canada dedicated to works of art on paper, holding over 6,000 works.

blocks.text: Upper Deer Lake Burnaby Houses: development and new projects

items.t: Shadbolt Centre expansion, 6450 Deer Lake Ave, City of Burnaby: the main building stays open during construction of the new theatre and arts studio; its cafe reopens in 2027 when they complete. Status: under construction (as of November 3, 2026).

Deer Lake Park boardwalk replacement, boat launch, City of Burnaby: closed beginning September 21 for full replacement, detour via Sperling Avenue and Deer Lake Drive, complete by winter 2027. Status: under construction (as of November 3, 2026).

blocks.text: Upper Deer Lake Burnaby Houses: getting around

items.t: Route 133 is the neighbourhood bus: Edmonds Station to Holdom Station via 18 Ave, Griffiths, Edmonds, Kingsway, Salisbury, Imperial, Walker, Stanley, Sperling, Oakland, Burris and Canada Way.
Park and museum parking lots are accessed from Deer Lake Avenue, and the beach-area lot from Sperling Avenue, per the City's park page.

blocks.text: Upper Deer Lake Burnaby Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Search the Heritage Burnaby database for the specific house before offering: an inventoried house can carry heritage expectations without a designation bylaw on title.
Check streamside title charges near the lake: a Streamside Restoration Plan must be registered on title as part of a Streamside Protection and Enhancement Area covenant and development permit.

blocks.text: Jared's take on Upper Deer Lake

Heritage-era homes near the lake’s west end and postwar homes on the upper streets by the Burnaby Village Museum make Upper Deer Lake the heritage pocket of Deer Lake. It’s the calmer, park-side alternative to Metrotown.
Upper Deer Lake home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

13 houses sold in Upper Deer Lake with a median price of $1,750,000 (the middle half sold between $1,688,000 and $1,915,000), taking a median of 48 days to sell at 94.8% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $643 per square foot, a median year built of 1979 and a median lot of 6,550 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Upper Deer Lake?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 14 houses listed in Upper Deer Lake. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Upper Deer Lake a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Upper Deer Lake had a sales ratio of 36%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Upper Deer Lake from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 10 houses sold in Upper Deer Lake over those 5 months, out of 251 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Upper Deer Lake?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: Which schools serve an Upper Deer Lake address?
faq.a: Buckingham Elementary, at 6066 Buckingham Avenue, kindergarten to Grade 7, and Burnaby Central Secondary, at 6011 Deer Lake Parkway, Grades 8 to 12, are the schools on the Province's Burnaby list beside this neighbourhood; Burnaby School District No. 41's School Locator decides catchment by address.

faq.q: Is there a bus through Upper Deer Lake itself?
faq.a: Yes. TransLink's route 133 timetable, effective September 7, 2026, runs from Edmonds Station via Imperial, Walker, Stanley, Sperling and Canada Way, with some trips via Deer Lake Parkway and Burnaby City Hall, then continues as route 129 at Holdom Station.

faq.q: Does living beside the park mean events next door?
faq.a: The park is a venue as well as a nature park. The City lists a Festival Lawn at Deer Lake Park as a performance venue overlooking the lake in the city's arts precinct, and states the park is open from dawn until dusk year-round.

faq.q: What did houses in Upper Deer Lake sell for?
faq.a: 13 houses sold in Upper Deer Lake between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,750,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Upper Deer Lake?
faq.a: The median was 48 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.8% of the last list price (8% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
